focus: Already-entered rows locked unticked (EnteredRows), interaction with the everyone auto-lock and DungeonEntry.Enter's everyone branch (stuckEntered), and the indicator label drawn in the DoCountAdjustInterface postfix
diffSource: since build 18 (2026-10-07T18:20:36Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Indicator label rect is not rounded the way vanilla rounds its count box
findings.detail: Vanilla rounds rect2 after building it from rect.center (TransferableUIUtility.cs:142-143). The postfix rounds `rect` but then builds `label` from rect.center.x - 17, which lands on a half pixel whenever the rect width is odd, so the Tiny text can blur. Adding `.Rounded()` to the `label` Rect in Source/Patches.cs:105 would line it up the way vanilla's checkbox is.

findings.title: "entered" label is fixed at 80px in Tiny font
findings.detail: English fits easily, but a longer translation of TUBAD_Enter_EnteredShort will wrap or clip inside the 25px-high box. The space is there: vanilla's count area is 240px wide and the label ends at x+183, so the width could grow to about 110px if translations are expected.

checked: verify_patches on Source/Patches.cs: all 10 targets bind, including TransferableUIUtility.DoCountAdjustInterface, and the postfix's (Rect rect, Transferable trad) parameter names match the target
DoCountAdjustInterface postfix: void postfix, returns early when both static sets are empty, TextBlock restores font and anchor, GUI.color reset; no other mod in the corpus patches the target
Vanilla DoCountAdjustInterfaceInternal: a non-interactive pawn row draws a disabled checkbox, no paint-drag and no arrows, so EnteredRows cannot be ticked from the UI
Label placement against vanilla's 240px count area (TransferableOneWayWidget.DoRow) and its 90x25 centred box: no overlap with the checkbox or the trade arrow (count is 0)
SelectionChanged: the everyone auto-lock skips EnteredRows and only undoes Locked rows, so entered rows are never unlocked or ticked
